ety.text: Borrowed from French atelier. Further from Latin assula (a diminutive of axis / assis (“axis, wheel, axle”)). Can be calqued as **стру́жечная. Ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₂eḱs- (whence also ось (osʹ)). Compare typologically Latin arēna (harēna) (whence аре́на (aréna)).
